input_adapter.character_count: Python len() of final Unicode selected_text, including all source labels, context IDs, references and newline separators
input_adapter.candidate_group_source: Only topic-bearing numeric non-boilerplate source table rows or paragraphs in the saved v2.1 training block store
input_adapter.context_rule: Bind source-visible period, unit, basis, table header and footnote in the same document and same table or bounded section; never infer a nearest heading across section/table boundaries
input_adapter.paragraph_rule: Use a numeric topic-bearing paragraph with its own explicit period/unit or a source-visible same-section heading/paragraph that supplies them
input_adapter.footnote_rule: All referenced footnotes must be resolvable to source-visible context in the same document; otherwise omit the group
input_adapter.selection: First eligible complete group for each fixed topic, then remaining complete groups by earnings-exhibit precedence, document, sequence and stable ID
input_adapter.context_sharing: Serialize each common source context once per event with a stable ID, then reference it from selected group lines; referenced text must be visible in selected_text
input_adapter.complete_group: Include the entire numeric source row or paragraph plus all required visible context and link labels, or omit it as a whole
input_adapter.model_visible_spans: Each selected source fragment has validated start/end offsets into actual selected_text, source document ID, source block ID and role

comparison.run_limit: One fixed-budget training-material comparison after preflight and synthetic tests
comparison.same_reference: Frozen 71-candidate v4 same-team review with 60 SOURCE_SUPPORTED and 11 AMBIGUOUS, unchanged from v2/v2.1
comparison.same_evaluator: Shared source-fragment and field-presence functions from v2.1 retention evaluator applied to actual serialized model-visible text per source document
comparison.strict_complete: Metric, literal value, period, unit, necessary basis, source-bound comparison context and required footnote evidence all present; ambiguous source status remains separate

disclosure: Rule design follows prior exposure to April-May development results. This is training-material engineering, not independent extraction or predictive validation.
